from: August book, night 23 (The Moon and the Stars)
p1: Long ago there were no city lights. At night, the whole sky sparkled with stars.
David looked up and sang to the Lord. “I see Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars!”
Then David asked, “What is man, that You think about him?” The sky is so big. Why would the Lord think about one person?
p2: But He does! David sang that the Lord made us a little lower than the angels. The Lord who made the stars was Jesus. He made them for Heavenly Father.
Heavenly Father is thinking of you right now. Tonight, peek at the sky or picture the stars. The One who made them knows you!
old: One night, a person looked up at the wide, dark sky and saw thousands of twinkling stars. It filled his heart with wonder, so he sang a song to Heavenly Father.
“Heavenly Father, You are so wonderful! You made the moon and the shining stars and put them in their places.”
Then he thought about something amazing. With all the great big sky and stars, Heavenly Father still knows and loves each one of us.
Even the littlest children are precious to Heavenly Father. He made the whole universe, and He still has room in His heart for you. How wonderful is that!
